claims.value: one source per (arm, SILAC channel, preparation); bio rep DGII-1=1, DGII-2=2, TelSyk light=3 in untreated/wild type group, TelSyk medium/heavy=1
claims.evidence: summary.txt puts DGII_1 and DGII_2 in separate MaxQuant Experiments (two independent 2-plex SILAC experiments -> independent light and heavy cultures -> bio rep 1 and 2 per factor group); the TEL-SYK arm (Aug 2016) is a third independent light culture (bio rep 3 in the untreated/wild type group, numbering unique per culture within the group). All six DG_TelSyk files are one MaxQuant Experiment with one proteome vial (RA3) and two pY vials (RA1, RA2): treated as one SILAC experiment (bio rep 1) whose two pY immunoprecipitations get distinct source names (pYIP1, pYIP2) because they are separate physical preparations. Proteome and pY-enriched preparations of the same mix get distinct source names (same culture -> same bio rep).

claims.value: light: untreated (DMSO vehicle, compound Dimethyl Sulfoxide); heavy: HSP90 Inhibitor (compound not available)
claims.evidence: Paper Methods: "For phosphoproteomic and protein expression profiling of DG75 and Daudi cells, the light-labeled cell batches were treated with dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), whereas the heavy-labeled cell batches were treated with the HSP90 inhibitors AT13387 or STA-9090." DGII is a 2-plex (light/heavy) design matching that sentence. Data check: in both DGII_1 and DGII_2 heavy/light shows the HSP90-inhibition heat-shock response (log2 H/L HSPA1A/B 3.74 and 2.92, DNAJB1 2.01/1.56, HSPH1 1.31/1.28) and loss of BCR-proximal pY (SYK pY352 -1.74/-2.29, LYN pY194 -2.55/-2.47, BTK pY223 -1.77/-2.26), as the paper reports for HSP90 inhibition. Which of AT13387/STA-9090 each experiment received is only in supplemental Figure 1C (not retrievable) -> compound not available. Control encoded as untreated (rule 4) with the vehicle in characteristics[compound]. NCIT:C156880 HSP90 Inhibitor, NCIT:C437 Dimethyl Sulfoxide.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 14 of 32 RAW files annotated (arms DGII and DG_TelSyk). Excluded and listed in annotations/BLOCKED.md: MaxQuant Experiment DD (Daudi; 6 files: KT_Pan_010816_030816_Daudi_hsp90_proteome1/2, KT_Pan_010816_090816_DD_hsp90_pY_1-1, 1-2, 2-1, 2-2) and DGI_w/DGI_X/DGI_Y (DG75; 12 files: KT_Pan_260116_090216_proteome_P-A_w-1, w-2, P-A_x-1, x-2, P-S_y-1, y-2 and the six matching KT_Pan_260116_090216_pY_* files). DD is a 3-plex but the paper only states light = DMSO / heavy = inhibitor; the medium channel and the per-channel compound (AT13387 vs STA-9090) are in supplemental Figure 1C only. DGI 3-plex channel identities are not described anywhere retrievable, and the data show that in each DGI run one of medium/heavy carries no HSP90-inhibitor response (log2 HSPA1A M/L vs H/L: w 3.23/0.00, X 0.00/3.54, Y -0.21/3.35), so DGI is a different, undocumented design.

Supplemental Materials and methods / supplemental Figure 1C (Blood data supplement) not retrievable: ashpublications.org returns a Cloudflare bot check (not bypassed); PMC copy has no supplement (pmc-prop-has-supplement no); Europe PMC supplementaryFiles: not open access; PMC OA S3 has no copy.

DGII rows: the heavy HSP90 inhibitor is AT13387 or STA-9090; which experiment (DGII_1 vs DGII_2) got which is undocumented, so characteristics[compound] = not available and both heavy channels share factor value HSP90 Inhibitor (they may be different compounds rather than replicates of one compound). Exposure time (paper: 24 h for DG75 pYome) not encoded because the link of DGII to that statement is inferred.

DG_TelSyk: whether pY sample 1 and 2 (vials RA1/RA2) are independent cultures or two immunoprecipitations of one SILAC mix is undocumented; encoded as one experiment (bio rep 1, as MaxQuant combined them in one Experiment and only one proteome vial exists) with distinct source names. BCR stimulation reagent for MS not stated in the main text (anti-IgM is stated only for Ca2+ flux).
Precursor tolerance 6 ppm is the paper's stated post-recalibration value; MaxQuant main-search tolerance per parameter group is not in parameters.txt (no mqpar.xml deposited).
Reduction/alkylation reagents and passage number not available.
Related deposit PXD003492 (Corso et al. PNAS 2016, same group) shares no raw files (0 name and 0 checksum overlap), so it is not a duplicate and was not annotated here.
